pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular dark polygons with jagged, non-linear boundaries and stellate perimeter features. Edge gradients are moderately soft at the current resolution. Spatial area of individual patches is largest on the neck and upper flank, decreasing in scale toward the posterior region.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light-colored interstitial pathways forming numerous tri-point junction nodes. The pathway pixel thickness is relatively uniform across the mid-flank, maintaining clear separation between all dark regions.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A high-frequency serrated 1D silhouette with low-to-moderate amplitude visible along the dorsal neck against the blurred background foliage.
dorsal_ridge_profile.contour_gaps: Localized structural breaks in the continuous mane line occur where two small, high-contrast silhouettes of external organisms are perched on the lateral-dorsal neck.

other_distinctive_markers: Two small avian organisms are visible clinging to the dorsal-lateral surface of the upper neck, creating localized high-contrast points against the pelage.
